# version

```go
import "github.com/kinorai/omnifeed/internal/version"
```

Package version exposes build\-time version metadata.

Version is set by GoReleaser at release time via \`\-ldflags="\-X ..."\`. The default below applies when running with \`go run\`, \`go build\`, or \`go test\`.

## Index

- [Variables](<#variables>)


## Variables

<a name="Version"></a>Version is the semver release string. Stamped by goreleaser.

```go
var Version = "dev"
```
